gaps.exactGap: Low-level inspectReversal fails closed, but no general facade returns a normalized eligible/blockers decision for an arbitrary selected load_id.
gaps.minimalDelta: Add a read-only eligibility adapter over RAW_LOAD_REGISTRY and existing reversal validation.
gaps.acceptance: Committed load with no later active revision is eligible; missing, non-committed, empty, reversing, reversed or superseded loads return explicit blocker codes without writes.

gaps.exactGap: IncrementalPublish.planReversal requires durable reversal records created after COMMIT_RAW; there is no pre-submit read-only preview of affected RAW rows, Publish series, aggregate scopes and latest changes.
gaps.minimalDelta: Build a bounded preview from the selected load and existing accepted dependency identities without writing RAW_REVERSAL_LOG.
gaps.acceptance: Preview identifies target table, row counts, restored predecessors, affected frequencies/series/aggregate scope and a deterministic snapshot fingerprint.

gaps.exactGap: RAW_REVERSAL_V4 currently substitutes a default reason when input.reason is blank.
gaps.minimalDelta: Facade rejects blank or trivial reason before enqueue; the data-plane handler remains unchanged.
gaps.acceptance: Submit cannot enqueue without a normalized user-provided reason meeting the bounded contract.

gaps.exactGap: No confirmation token binds target load, eligibility snapshot, impact preview and reason to the later submit.
gaps.minimalDelta: Return a deterministic preview token and require the exact token at submit.
gaps.acceptance: Any load, lineage, preview or reason drift invalidates confirmation and causes zero writes.

gaps.exactGap: No public DEV facade selects an arbitrary load_id and enqueues RAW_REVERSAL_V4 with deterministic idempotency.
gaps.minimalDelta: Add one thin submit function that revalidates the preview and calls OperationEngine.enqueue/run only.
gaps.acceptance: Repeated submit for the same confirmed preview returns the same operation_id and never creates a second reversal.

gaps.exactGap: OperationEngine.status returns full operation and step history; there is no compact rollback terminal evidence for routine operator use.
gaps.minimalDelta: Materialize no new data table; derive bounded evidence from OPERATION_QUEUE, RAW_LOAD_REGISTRY, RAW_REVERSAL_LOG and checkpoint summaries.
gaps.acceptance: Status exposes operation_id, target/reversal load IDs, terminal status, reversed rows, Publish/aggregate completion, audit result, errors and idempotency without oversized step output.

eligibilityPolicy.reversingBehavior: Return active operation/continuation guidance; do not enqueue a second operation.
